announcements.title: Manual Update Required for v1.1.0
announcements.message: In-app automatic updates are broken in v1.1.0. Please download the latest version manually once from splitwave.app or GitHub.
announcements.markdown:
### In-App Update Notice

Due to an updater issue in version `1.1.0`, automatic updates fail with `The resource id is invalid`.

To update to the latest version, please download and install Splitwave manually once:
- [Official Website](https://splitwave.app)
- [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/Horuse/Splitwave/releases)

Your existing pipelines, presets, and audio configuration will be preserved automatically.
